identify_affected_packages.expected_solution: Two unrelated bug fixes ship together in v7.23.6. PR #16166 fixes `retainLines` indentation in `@babel/generator` (`packages/babel-generator/src/printer.ts` plus its test in `packages/babel-generator/test/index.js`). PR #16011 fixes the `iterableIsArray` assumption in `@babel/plugin-transform-for-of` (`packages/babel-plugin-transform-for-of/src/index.ts`) when the iterable variable is shadowed inside the loop. Affected sibling packages: (1) `@babel/plugin-transform-for-of` itself (the source fix and fixture updates) and (2) `@babel/preset-env` because its integration fixtures `packages/babel-preset-env/test/fixtures/plugins-integration/for-of-array-block-scoping/` and `packages/babel-preset-env/test/fixtures/plugins-integration/for-of-array-block-scoping-2/` exercise the changed plugin and are regenerated.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify @babel/plugin-transform-for-of as affected (source change in packages/babel-plugin-transform-for-of/src/index.ts)
Must identify @babel/preset-env as affected via its integration fixtures
Must reference packages/babel-generator/src/printer.ts as the retainLines fix site
Should note both PRs ride together in the v7.23.6 release

classify_change_impact.expected_solution: Both changes are bug fixes — overall semver = **patch**. `@babel/generator` = patch (output of the printer is corrected only when `retainLines` is true; default `retainLines=false` paths are unchanged). `@babel/plugin-transform-for-of` = patch (correct transformation when iterable variable is reassigned/shadowed in the loop body — previously the optimization assumed array-ness incorrectly, producing wrong runtime behavior). `@babel/preset-env` = patch (no API changes; only integration test fixtures regenerated to match the corrected plugin output).
evaluation_criteria: Must classify the overall release as `patch` and justify as bug-fix only
Must classify @babel/plugin-transform-for-of as patch with reasoning that the prior behavior was incorrect under variable shadowing
Must classify @babel/preset-env as patch with reasoning that only fixtures change (no public API)
Should note that retainLines fix is conditional on the retainLines option being enabled

identify_boundary_violations.expected_solution: Concrete violations: (1) `packages/babel-generator/src/printer.ts` — change in indentation handling when `retainLines` is enabled (function that decides whitespace before tokens); (2) `packages/babel-generator/test/index.js` — coverage for the new behavior; (3) `packages/babel-plugin-transform-for-of/src/index.ts` — the visitor that previously assumed `iterableIsArray` regardless of variable shadowing; (4) the new fixture `for-of-modify-iterable` (input + output) added under packages/babel-plugin-transform-for-of/test/fixtures/assumption-iterableIsArray/; (5) `packages/babel-plugin-transform-for-of/package.json` — version bump or dependency update; (6) integration fixtures for `for-of-array-block-scoping` (exec, output, and the `-2` variant) added under packages/babel-preset-env/test/fixtures/plugins-integration/. PR file counts: #16166=2 files, #16011=13 files.
